summary: Frontend-only verification of the /properti/:id bug fix and storytelling PropertyDetailPage. All 13 user-listed acceptance criteria pass. Detail button + image click both navigate correctly to /properti/{id}. PropertyDetailPage renders hero (title, green price, location, KT/KM/luas), back-link, WhatsApp CTA (target=_blank, href starts with https://wa.me/6285119833362), Simulasi KPR button (navigates to /kpr), 4 day-story cards (06.30/12.00/18.30/22.00), Facilities (6/6 items), Related listings (3 cards from same city), Gallery thumbs (5, clickable, switch hero). Direct URL /properti/list-1 loads; /properti/xxx-invalid redirects to /cari-properti. Header nav shows exactly ['Beli','KPR','Kerjasama'] on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: PropertyDetailPage.jsx is 562 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider extracting Hero, Storytelling and Sidebar sections into sub-components for maintainability.
Gallery uses 4 hard-coded Unsplash URLs identical for every listing - long-term should come from item.gallery in mock.js for realism.
Specifications 'Sertifikat: SHM' is hard-coded regardless of listing - should be per-item.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix (registering /properti/:id route) is verified working end-to-end. ListingCard image area and Detail button both link correctly. WhatsApp phone is 6285119833362. All data-testids in PropertyDetailPage are present: prop-back-link, prop-wa-btn, prop-kpr-btn, prop-like-btn, prop-share-btn, prop-side-wa-btn, prop-side-kpr-btn, prop-final-wa-btn. Related section renders ListingCard which reuses listing-card-{id} and listing-detail-{id} testids.
rca of the issue: Root cause: PropertyDetailPage.jsx component existed but no <Route path='/properti/:id'> was registered in App.js Routes tree, so clicking Detail led to an unmatched route (blank). Fix: import PropertyDetailPage and add the Route inside <Routes> (App.js line 63). Verified by clicking Detail button on /cari-properti, direct URL access, and invalid id redirect.
